# GraphQLDependency.(constructor)

Registers a description against its type. Not called directly — the constructor is `protected` so that [Dependency](/api/graphql-dependency/latest/graphql-dependency.dependency/) and [GraphQLDependency.create()](/api/graphql-dependency/latest/graphql-dependency.graphqldependency.create/) stay the only way in, which is what keeps one description per type.

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected constructor(
    type: GraphQLObjectType);
```
